english.text:
There are **60 minutes** in an hour.

This is a standard unit of time measurement used globally. Since an hour is defined as 3,600 seconds, you simply divide that by 60 to get the number of minutes.

english.q: Which ocean is the largest?
english.text:
The **Pacific Ocean** is the largest ocean in the world.

It covers more than 63 million square miles (165 million square kilometers), which is roughly 30% of Earth's total surface area. This makes it significantly larger than the second-largest ocean, the Atlantic, and about 2.5 times the size of the Arctic Ocean. Its vast expanse makes it the longest ocean as well, stretching approximately 15,000 miles (24,000 km) from the Arctic to the Southern Ocean.
